QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Neinheart's Request
QuestInfo.0: Empress Cygnus told you to speak to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart gave you a brief overview of the Commerci Republic, and your mission there. He has instructed you to head to #m104000000# and find Parbell the Explorer.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart gave you a brief overview of the Commerci Republic, and your mission there. He instructed you to head to #m104000000# and find Parbell the Explorer. Parbell should be able to arrange your passage to Commerci.
